Rename a profile; its ID and state directory do not change

Usage: larp cc profile rename [OPTIONS] <NAME> <NEW_NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>      Profile name
  <NEW_NAME>  New profile name

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
